snippet.title: Letter Lost - Official Launch Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Letter Lost, a story-rich horror adventure game developed by FlatNine Games. Players will take on the position as the only employee at the Kharnym Isle Post Office to stamp, sort, and deliver mail. Take note of elusive ongoings and escape in Letter Lost, launching on June 10 for PC (Steam).
